00063 void LFNoise0UGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00064 {
00065  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00066  float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00067  float currentFreq = *(inputs[Freq].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel));
00068  
00069  unsigned long s1, s2, s3;
00070  random.get(s1, s2, s3);
00071  
00072  do {
00073   if (counter <= 0) {
00074    counter = int(UGen::getSampleRate() / max(currentFreq, 0.001f));
00075    counter = max(1, counter);
00076    currentValue = Ran088::nextBiFloat(s1,s2,s3);
00077   }
00078   int samplesThisTime = min(numSamplesToProcess, counter);
00079   numSamplesToProcess -= samplesThisTime;
00080   counter -= samplesThisTime;
00081   
00082   while(samplesThisTime--)
00083   {
00084    *outputSamples++ = currentValue;
00085   }
00086   
00087  } while (numSamplesToProcess);
00088  
00089  random.set(s1, s2, s3);
00090 }

00110 void LFNoise1UGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00111 {
00112  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00113  float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00114  float currentFreq = *(inputs[Freq].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel));
00115  
00116  unsigned long s1, s2, s3;
00117  random.get(s1, s2, s3);
00118  
00119  do {
00120   if (counter <= 0) {
00121    counter = int(UGen::getSampleRate() / max(currentFreq, 0.001f));
00122    counter = max(1, counter);
00123    float nextValue = Ran088::nextBiFloat(s1,s2,s3);
00124    slope = (nextValue - currentValue) / counter;
00125   }
00126   int samplesThisTime = min(numSamplesToProcess, counter);
00127   numSamplesToProcess -= samplesThisTime;
00128   counter -= samplesThisTime;
00129   
00130   while(samplesThisTime--)
00131   {
00132    *outputSamples++ = currentValue;
00133    currentValue += slope;
00134   }
00135   
00136  } while (numSamplesToProcess);
00137  
00138  random.set(s1, s2, s3);

00141 LFNoise2UGenInternal::LFNoise2UGenInternal(UGen const& freq) throw()
00142 : UGenInternal(NumInputs),
00143  //random((unsigned int)this * 123463463UL + 423815L + rand(8277)),
00144  random(rand(0x7fffffff)),
00145  currentValue(random.nextBiFloat()),
00146  nextValue(random.nextBiFloat()),
00147  nextMidPoint(nextValue * 0.5f),
00148  curve(0.f),
00149  slope(0.f),
00150  counter(0)
00151 {
00152  inputs[Freq] = freq;
00153  
00154  initValue(currentValue);
00155 }
00156 
00157 UGenInternal* LFNoise2UGenInternal::getChannel(const int channel) throw()
00158 {
00159  return new LFNoise2UGenInternal(inputs[Freq].getChannel(channel));
00160 }

00162 void LFNoise2UGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00163 {
00164  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00165  float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00166  float currentFreq = *(inputs[Freq].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel));
00167  
00168  unsigned long s1, s2, s3;
00169  random.get(s1, s2, s3);
00170  
00171  do {
00172   if (counter <= 0) {
00173    float value = nextValue;
00174    nextValue = Ran088::nextBiFloat(s1,s2,s3);
00175    currentValue = nextMidPoint;
00176    nextMidPoint = (nextValue + value) * 0.5f;
00177    
00178    counter = int(UGen::getSampleRate() / max(currentFreq, 0.001f));
00179    counter = max(2, counter);
00180    float fseglen = (float)counter;
00181    curve = 2.f * (nextMidPoint - currentValue - fseglen * slope) / (fseglen * fseglen + fseglen);
00182   }
00183   int samplesThisTime = min(numSamplesToProcess, counter);
00184   numSamplesToProcess -= samplesThisTime;
00185   counter -= samplesThisTime;
00186   
00187   while(samplesThisTime--)
00188   {
00189    *outputSamples++ = currentValue;
00190    slope += curve;
00191    currentValue += slope;
00192   }
00193   
00194  } while (numSamplesToProcess);
00195  
00196  random.set(s1, s2, s3);
00197 }
